name: Access Request
title: Access Request
description: A compact avatar pill that unfolds into access requests with shared avatar motion, individual approve and decline actions, and coordinated spring reflow.
summary: An inline request-review notification based on the supplied motion reference. Shared avatars move into their rows as the pill unfolds; decisions show pending and outcome states before rows leave and the queue settles. Supports live data, retries, focus recovery, cancellation, both themes and reduced motion.
highlights: Shared avatar elements travel between the compact stack and expanded rows
Interruptible spring-driven panel height, header crossfade, count badge and chevron
Independent asynchronous decisions with duplicate-click guards and AbortSignal cancellation
Successful rows acknowledge the decision before exiting; remaining rows and avatars reflow together
Retryable inline errors and live queue updates preserve unresolved requests
Light and dark themes, keyboard focus recovery, inert collapsed content and reduced motion
Transparent component-only showcase with adjustable width, stiffness, damping and speed
anatomy: Named region with a compact review trigger, disclosure control and dismiss button
Shared avatar layer with an overflow count
Inert collapsible panel containing a semantic request list
Each row contains requester details, approve/decline controls and an optional retry alert
Polite action announcements and an empty queue summary

physics.description: One scoped timeline coordinates measured panel height, the shared avatar layer, disclosure icon, header and row positions. New transitions start from current values. Each decision has a separate scoped outcome and exit sequence.

accessibility.aria: Named region and disclosure controls with aria-expanded/aria-controls. Collapsed content is inert and hidden to assistive technology. Decisions are labelled with requester names, pending rows expose aria-busy, safe failures use alerts, and outcomes are announced politely.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Panel, avatar, row and exit changes apply immediately; pending indicators remain static and all controls stay usable.

keyboard.description: Move among disclosure, dismissal and per-person actions.
Open, collapse, approve, decline or dismiss the focused control.
Collapse the expanded panel and focus its toggle; dismiss the widget when already collapsed.

bestPractices: Use a distinct request ID for each access request, even when the same person requests access again.
Authorize and persist decisions on your server; this component handles presentation and callback state.
Remove successful items in onResolved, after their exit has finished.
Honor AbortSignal and make decision endpoints idempotent; cancelling the UI cannot roll back a decision already committed by a server.
Keep names concise and supply safe descriptions and error messages.
The inline panel does not trap focus or automatically open on hover.
The showcase only simulates local decisions and does not change real access permissions.

props.name: requests
props.description: Live queue of requesters with unique, stable IDs, names and optional handle, avatar URL, emoji fallback, color and description. Newly received requests join the queue; externally removed requests animate out.

props.name: onDecision
props.type: (person: AccessRequester, decision: AccessDecision, signal: AbortSignal) => void | Promise<void>
props.description: Commit an approved or declined decision. Resolve only after success; reject to retain the row with a safe retry message. Honor AbortSignal to cancel work on removal, dismissal or unmount.

props.name: onResolved
props.description: Runs after the successful row exit. Use this callback to remove the request from parent state without interrupting its animation.

props.name: onDismiss
props.description: Runs after the complete widget exit. Dismissal cancels pending callbacks; it does not decline the queue. Remount to display the widget again.

props.name: expanded
props.description: Optional controlled disclosure state. Pair with onExpandedChange.

props.name: defaultExpanded
props.description: Initial disclosure state in uncontrolled mode.

props.name: onExpandedChange
props.description: Receives toggle and Escape collapse requests.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disable decisions while preserving disclosure and dismissal controls.

props.name: width
props.description: Preferred width, clamped to 280–480px and constrained by the parent.

props.name: errorMessage
props.defaultValue: "Couldn’t save this decision. Please try again."
props.description: Safe user-facing text for failed actions. Server errors are not rendered.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes for the notification shell.
